description: AlphaMissense per-residue constraint by site class and gnomAD LoF constraint for ASPDH
code:
import os, requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
D='/tmp/c'; os.makedirs(D,exist_ok=True)
OUT='/agent/jobs/7b68df0a-e64f-459f-b8e1-5042bbc40de7/provenance'

# --- AlphaMissense (re-downloaded; executor filesystem resets between calls) ---
r=S.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-A6ND91-F1-aa-substitutions.csv",timeout=180)
open(f'{D}/am.csv','w').write(r.text)
am=pd.read_csv(f'{D}/am.csv')
am['pos']=am['protein_variant'].str.extract(r'(\d+)').astype(int)
per=am.groupby('pos')['am_pathogenicity'].mean()

COF=[13,14,15,16,17,40,41,42,43,75,76,79,83,96,97,126,189,260]
BOTH=[127,192,193,256]; SUB=[152,190,223,225,255,257]
MAPPED=COF+BOTH+SUB
bg=per.drop(index=MAPPED)

rows=[]
for lbl,pos in [('cofactor',COF),('shared',BOTH),('substrate',SUB)]:
    v=per.reindex(pos); u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(v,bg,alternative='greater')
    rows.append(dict(site_class=lbl,n=len(v),mean_am=round(v.mean(),4),bg_mean=round(bg.mean(),4),
                     MWU_p_greater=p,rank_biserial=round(2*u/(len(v)*len(bg))-1,4)))
cls=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(cls.to_string(index=False))
uu,pp=stats.mannwhitneyu(per.reindex(COF),per.reindex(SUB),alternative='two-sided')
print(f"\ncofactor vs substrate classes: MWU p={pp:.3f}")

# --- gnomAD constraint ---
gq={"query":'{gene(gene_symbol:"ASPDH", reference_genome:GRCh38){gene_id gnomad_constraint{exp_lof obs_lof oe_lof oe_lof_upper pLI exp_mis obs_mis oe_mis}}}'}
gc=S.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api",json=gq,timeout=120).json()['data']['gene']['gnomad_constraint']
print("\ngnomAD v2.1.1 constraint, ASPDH:",{k:(round(v,3) if isinstance(v,float) else v) for k,v in gc.items()})

# --- provenance table ---
pt=pd.DataFrame({'pos':per.index,'am_mean_pathogenicity':per.values})
pt['site_class']=['cofactor' if p in COF else 'shared' if p in BOTH else 'substrate' if p in SUB else 'other' for p in pt['pos']]
pt.to_csv(f'{OUT}/alphamissense_per_position.csv',index=False)
cls.to_csv(f'{OUT}/alphamissense_site_class_stats.csv',index=False)
pd.DataFrame([gc]).to_csv(f'{OUT}/gnomad_constraint_ASPDH.csv',index=False)
print("\nwrote alphamissense_per_position.csv, alphamissense_site_class_stats.csv, gnomad_constraint_ASPDH.csv")

# --- figure ---
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,8.5))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,3,height_ratios=[1.15,1],hspace=0.42,wspace=0.3)
colm={'cofactor':'#1f77b4','shared':'#7b3f99','substrate':'#d62728'}

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
ax.plot(per.index,per.values,color='0.65',lw=1.0,zorder=1)
ax.axhline(bg.mean(),ls='--',color='0.3',lw=1,zorder=2)
ax.text(285,bg.mean(),f' rest of protein\n mean {bg.mean():.2f}',va='center',fontsize=8,color='0.3')
for lbl,pos in [('cofactor',COF),('shared',BOTH),('substrate',SUB)]:
    ax.scatter(pos,per.reindex(pos).values,s=58,color=colm[lbl],zorder=3,edgecolor='w',lw=0.6,label=f'{lbl} site (n={len(pos)})')
for p in [225,255,257,223]:
    ax.annotate(f'{p}',(p,per[p]),textcoords='offset points',xytext=(0,9),ha='center',fontsize=8,color='#d62728')
ax.axvspan(1,63,color='0.9',zorder=0); ax.axvspan(95,144,color='0.9',zorder=0)
ax.text(32,0.03,'lost in isoform 2',ha='center',fontsize=8,color='0.45')
ax.text(119,0.03,'lost in isoform 2',ha='center',fontsize=8,color='0.45')
ax.set_xlim(0,283); ax.set_ylim(0,1.0)
ax.set_xlabel('human ASPDH residue position (A6ND91, 283 aa)')
ax.set_ylabel('mean AlphaMissense pathogenicity')
ax.set_title('A. Per-residue AlphaMissense constraint across ASPDH, with structurally mapped NAD and substrate sites',fontsize=10.5,loc='left')
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc='lower right',framealpha=0.95)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
order=['cofactor','shared','substrate']
dat=[per.reindex(COF).values,per.reindex(BOTH).values,per.reindex(SUB).values]
bp=ax.boxplot(dat,labels=order,widths=0.55,patch_artist=True,showfliers=False)
for b,l in zip(bp['boxes'],order): b.set_facecolor(colm[l]); b.set_alpha(0.35)
for i,(d,l) in enumerate(zip(dat,order)):
    ax.scatter(np.full(len(d),i+1)+np.linspace(-0.13,0.13,len(d)),d,s=22,color=colm[l],zorder=3)
ax.axhline(bg.mean(),ls='--',color='0.3',lw=1)
for i,row in cls.iterrows():
    ax.text(i+1,1.02,f"p={row.MWU_p_greater:.1e}",ha='center',fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_ylim(0,1.12); ax.set_ylabel('mean AlphaMissense pathogenicity')
ax.set_title('B. All three site classes are equally constrained\n(cofactor vs substrate p = %.2f)'%pp,fontsize=10,loc='left')

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
labels=['LoF','missense']
obs=[gc['obs_lof'],gc['obs_mis']]; exp=[gc['exp_lof'],gc['exp_mis']]
x=np.arange(2); w=0.36
ax.bar(x-w/2,exp,w,label='expected',color='0.75')
ax.bar(x+w/2,obs,w,label='observed',color='#2ca02c')
for i,(o,e) in enumerate(zip(obs,exp)):
    ax.text(i,max(o,e)*1.05,f'o/e = {o/e:.2f}',ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labels); ax.set_yscale('log'); ax.set_ylim(5,900)
ax.set_ylabel('variant count (log scale)')
ax.set_title('C. gnomAD: no population constraint\npLI = %.1e, LOEUF = %.2f'%(gc['pLI'],gc['oe_lof_upper']),fontsize=10,loc='left')
ax.legend(fontsize=8)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,2]); ax.axis('off')
txt=("D. What the orthogonal checks add\n\n"
     "AlphaMissense ranks the degraded substrate-site\n"
     "positions (H223, V225, V255, G257) as pathogenic-\n"
     "leaning, at the same level as the intact NAD site.\n"
     "The substrate half-site is therefore conserved and\n"
     "constrained in its vertebrate form, not decaying.\n\n"
     "gnomAD gives the opposite signal at gene level:\n"
     "25 observed LoF vs 30.5 expected, pLI ~ 0,\n"
     "LOEUF 1.14, missense o/e 1.05. Human ASPDH\n"
     "tolerates complete loss of function in the\n"
     "population.\n\n"
     "Caveat: AlphaMissense is trained on MSA and\n"
     "AlphaFold structure, so it is only partly\n"
     "independent of the conservation analysis.")
ax.text(0,1,txt,va='top',fontsize=8.6,family='DejaVu Sans')
plt.show()
